name: Spell Check
description: Underlines misspelled words in Markdown and text files and in source files' comments when they open or are saved; fixes the word at the cursor from hunspell's suggestions. Needs hunspell and a dictionary; written in C++, built once with the system's C++ compiler.

commands.name: Spell: Fix the Word at the Cursor
Spell: Add the Word at the Cursor to My Dictionary
